commit.message: chore: bump to release 2.9.13
chore!: drop support for Python 3.9

chore: drop scaleway build support

We are now building arm64 packages on Github Action runners
fix: fix handling of PostgreSQL 18 exceptions

Build CPython 3.15 wheels

Signed-off-by: Edgar Ramírez Mondragón <edgarrm358@gmail.com>
ci: only attempt triggering documentation refresh when pushing on main repo

chore: add pyproject.toml file to declare a PEP 517 build backend

Close #1788

fix: fix parsing of malformed int64 input in arrays

The error might have been used for something cheeky, but it requires
control of a malicious PostgreSQL server.

Report provided by Yonatan Drori from Tenzai.

fix: fix parsing of malformed bytea input

The error might have been used for something cheeky, but it requires
control of a malicious PostgreSQL server.

Report provided by Yonatan Drori from Tenzai.
